description:
Havells Artemis 1200mm ceiling fan is an energy saving high-speed fan built for strong air delivery and quiet comfort in bedrooms, living rooms, and offices. The 1200mm sweep spreads airflow across the room, so you feel a steady breeze even during sticky summer afternoons. Its aerodynamic blades push air efficiently, helping you stay cool without running the regulator at max all day.

Designed for low-noise operation, the motor runs smooth and calm—ideal for sleeping, studying, and work calls. The elegant, modern body fits well with contemporary interiors, while double ball bearings support long, reliable performance with less friction. If you want a dependable Havells ceiling fan that cools fast, looks premium, and helps control electricity bills, Artemis is a smart upgrade for everyday comfort.
